     package com.cowave.search.common.health
     import org.springframework.boot.health.contributor.Health
     import org.springframework.boot.health.contributor.HealthIndicator
     @Component("elasticsearch")
     class ElasticsearchHealthIndicator(
         private val clusterRepository: ClusterRepository,
         private val clientFactory: ElasticsearchClientFactory,
     ) : HealthIndicator {
         override fun health(): Health {
             val clusters = clusterRepository.findAll()
             if (clusters.isEmpty()) return Health.up().withDetail("message", "등록된 클러스터 없음").build()
             val details = mutableMapOf<String, Any>()
             var hasFailure = false
             clusters.forEach { cluster ->
                 val status = runCatching {
                     val client = clientFactory.getClient(cluster.id)
                     if (client.ping().value()) "UP" else "DOWN"
                 }.getOrElse { "DOWN: ${it.message}" }
                 details["${cluster.name}(${cluster.id})"] = status
                 if (!status.startsWith("UP")) hasFailure = true
